flows:
Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/signin?demo=1 then Click the "Sign in" button
Go to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/app/shield
Type "AdaK9zXw2LmQ8rTvB3nYc7HsP4kJe6FgD1oWu5Ra2Fx" into the "Paste a Solana, Ethereum or Base address" field
Click "Check address"
Assert the result says "Blocked"
Assert the result says it looks like Ada’s saved address but isn’t

remark: click: Clicking the Sign in button in the sign-in form
assert: the result says it looks like Ada’s saved address but isn’t

summary:
You asked to sign in, open the Shield page, and check the provided wallet address.
The Shield page was opened and the address AdaK9zXw2LmQ8rTvB3nYc7HsP4kJe6FgD1oWu5Ra2Fx was submitted for checking.
The result marked the address as “Blocked” and warned that it resembles Ada’s saved address but is not the same address.
